comment: The CI receiver configurations deliberately declare a Complex Subject so events are generated for it; Complex Subjects are not yet listed in CAEP Interop Profile 2.5, see https://github.com/openid/sharedsignals/issues/351

The emulated transmitter of the paired receiver test sends events for the Complex Subject declared in the CI receiver configuration; Complex Subjects are not yet listed in CAEP Interop Profile 2.5, see https://github.com/openid/sharedsignals/issues/351. The block name varies with the event type that carries the Complex Subject, hence the wildcard
